📌 *Benefits are available exclusively to attendees who participate in the live masterclass.*

**[Secure your spot today](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/microsoft-copilot-with-defender?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=microsoft_fy26_q3&utm_content=master_classes)** and gain the knowledge to confidently protect Microsoft Copilot with Microsoft's trusted security and identity solutions.
